"""End-to-end batch fuzz through submission/main.py with strict JSON checking."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from reference import ref_compile

def gen_job(rng):
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fz', '/workspace/dev/fuzz.py')
    fz = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(fz)
    return fz.gen_job(rng)

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0
    rounds = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 20
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env['NETNOMOS_DEPS'] = '/workspace/vendor'
    for r in range(rounds):
        njobs = rng.randint(1, 4)
        jobs = [gen_job(rng) for _ in range(njobs)]
        expected = {'results':[ref_compile(j) for j in jobs]}
        proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                              input=json.dumps({'jobs':jobs}), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60)
        assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
        out = json.loads(proc.stdout)
        if out != expected:
            print('MISMATCH round', r)
            print(json.dumps({'jobs':jobs}))
            print('got ', json.dumps(out))
            print('want', json.dumps(expected))
            sys.exit(1)
    print('pipeline fuzz OK', rounds, 'rounds, seed', seed)

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
